notes.title: UI improvements & small fixes
notes.content: This update brings some UI improvements and some small fixes. More UI improvements and general improvements are planned.

notes.title: Fixed logging in bug
notes.content: A bug has been fixed which prevented players from logging in.

notes.title: Update #37
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33474550/c80839488c9ae3a4c9b9f34d902c61be299c9f13.jpg[/img]
- Added a new map: London
- Added PvE kd leaderboards
- Fixed a bug where score ui was visible in Realistic, it is now disabled
- Fixed a bug where weapon skins were not showing on SMG's
- Optimization

notes.title: Update #36
notes.content:
- Improved score UI, you can now see if you are winning or losing, and what the highest enemy score is in the bottom left corner without the need to press tab. 
- Increased headshot damage in Realistic gamemode: now you will almost always get a one shot kill when you hit an enemy in the head.
- Fixed a bug where the scoreboard did not sort players or bots correctly if the score limit was set to 10000.
- UI Optimization

notes.title: Update #35 - 1 year in Early Access!
notes.content:
- Bots can now score and win games, so playing with bots got much more interesting.
- If you win a match against bots, rewards now depend on the selected difficulty
- Bots now start fighting the first time you spawn, so they don't have a head start.
- Increased bot running speed, bot running speed now depends on their weapon.
- Small UI and text improvements
- Fixed a missing wall collider in Single Player
- Small final bullet cam improvements

notes.title: Operation Lone Wolf Update #34
notes.content:
[b]A small update to improve the gunplay:[/b]
[list]
[*] Recoil now not only moves your camera up and to the left or right, but also rotates it slightly to feel more realistic and responsive
[*] Added new hitmarkers for a better feedback feeling when you hit a shot
[/list]

- Increased firerate of the Colt M1911
- Fixed a lighting bug which appeared since the last update
- Improved game stability

notes.title: DOGFIGHT [Operation Lone Wolf Update #25]
notes.content:
[h1]Trailer:[/h1]
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VtkdhJVnOZ0&feature=youtu.be
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33474550/b6ea240c4801283aee993acba34e38b1a6d0f0c9.jpg[/img]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33474550/1c159f24c7320d90ffc28b0359d8ffcd97d179da.jpg[/img]
[h1]Dogfight[/h1]
I wanted to add something completely different, so here it is. Dogfight. Fight against AI controlled enemies to earn credits and increase your highscore. I've added highscore leaderboards to Dogfight as well, so you can compete with other players to get in the top 10. With the credits you earn you can buy or upgrade planes.
It is still in early development, more content like new planes, maps, modes etc. will be added over time. Right now there are two planes, one map and one mode available to play.

[h1]Details[/h1]
[list]
[*]Increased the amount of money and XP you get for killing bots by 100%
[*]Increased headshot damage in the gamemode Realistic by 33%
[*]All weapons and perks are no longer unlocked from the start in PvE, because you now earn money and XP in PvE to buy weapons, and level up your character
[*]Most challenges can now be completed in PvE
[*]You earn more money with each kill the higher your killstreak is. This starts when your killstreak is higher than 3
[*]Added a new skin: Blue Steel
[*]Added bullet tracers to bots
[*]Fixed a bug where you could walk through some objects in the new map Palace
[*]Increased recoil for all weapons in the Gamemode Realistic, and fixed a bug where the increased recoil was only vertical, now it is horizontal as well.
[*]Increased recoil for all weapons when the +40% bullet damage perk is selected
[*]Added a few small sound effects
[/list]

notes.title: Operation Lone Wolf Update #1
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33474550/c7147a23bbbd2dc5e13a612e4eb658b670130341.jpg[/img]
Hi! This next update adds some improvements and a new gamemode to the game. I also have made some progress on the first single player mission. 

[h1]Details[/h1]
[list]
[*]New Gamemode: Realistic
In this gamemode your HUD is disabled, there are no hitmarkers, no killfeed, and recoil is increased to give it a more realistic feel.

[*]Killing Bots now gives you XP and money to unlock new weapons in multiplayer, and level up your character. 

[*]Killcams are added to PvE, so you know where you got shot from (not available in all gamemodes, for example not in the new Realistic gamemode).

[*]Added some new vegetation to the Desert map (cactuses).

[*]Fixed a bug where Bots would ignore you when you where extremely close to them.
[/list]
I will try to finish the first mission soon, but I also want to make sure to make it as good as possible. Stay tuned!

notes.title: Operation Lone Wolf Patch #2
notes.content:
-Added an option to unequip the Springfield scope.
-Sniper Only is now always one shot to kill.
-Added some PvE statistics (kills, deaths, headshots), they are found in the PvE training mode.
-Fixed a bug where a scope camera was enabled on the Kar98 and Springfield iron sight, without being used. (which caused frame drops)
-Disabled music in the Deploy Menu.
-Fixed a bug where a bot with a shotgun would ignore being shot at when the person shooting at him was out of his range, he will now try to run towards you and fire when possible.

Right now I am working on a PvE leveling and unlock system, I will add it to the game as soon as I can.

notes.title: Operation Lone Wolf Patch #1
notes.content:

- Fixed a bug where performance decreased when killed while using a killstreak

Working on an offline progression system, seperate from multiplayer.

notes.title: New in Operation Lone Wolf: Weapon Skins
notes.content:
When you get to level 3, a weapon skin shop is unlocked to buy skins for your weapons. Skins can only be bought with in-game money, which is earned by completing challenges, winning games and playing well.
